title_zh: 托福综合写作（Integrated Writing）满分范文：自主无人机配送能否取代城市货车（阅读三论点 vs. 听力逐点反驳）

paragraphs.section_or_role_zh: 托福综合写作 / 学术争议正反交锋段（Point-by-Point Reading vs. Lecture Synthesis）
paragraphs.paragraph_intent_zh: 我这一段想写托福综合写作（Integrated Writing）或文献争议交锋段：先用 1 句话精准概括阅读材料（或正方文献）的分论点，再用 2–3 句话详细呈现教授讲座（或反方实证）是如何釜底抽薪推翻该论点的。
paragraphs.cohesion_formula: Reading Claim -> Lecturer's Direct Challenge -> Specific Counter-Mechanism -> Reversed Outcome. 绑定逻辑规则：L008, L019.
paragraphs.paragraph_en: The reading passage contends that replacing urban delivery vans with autonomous quadcopter drones will substantially reduce last-mile transportation energy consumption, citing the lighter weight of aerial vehicles. The lecturer directly challenges this premise by examining energy efficiency per kilogram of delivered freight. Specifically, she points out that unlike ground vehicles supported passively by road surfaces, multi-rotor drones must expend continuous battery power simply to counteract gravity and headwinds while carrying only a single parcel per trip. Consequently, servicing a dense apartment block via individual drone flights consumes nearly three times more energy per package than a single consolidated van route.

paragraphs.section_or_role_zh: 静态多组数据横向对比与倍差/占比凸显段（Cross-Group Proportions）
paragraphs.paragraph_intent_zh: 我这一段想写静态柱状图或饼图的主体段：横向对比不同国家/不同模型在不同开销维度上的占比差异，灵活运用倍数（double/triple）、分数（nearly a third）与排序结构。
paragraphs.cohesion_formula: Dominant Item with Multiplier -> Sharp Cross-Group Contrast -> Pooled Minor Items -> Structural Synthesis. 绑定逻辑规则：L009, L010.
paragraphs.paragraph_en: Within edge-device inference workloads, attention matrix computation consumes the largest fraction of total energy at 48%, exactly double the power drawn by feed-forward layers (24%). A strikingly different profile emerges in onboard robotic control loops, where high-frequency sensor preprocessing dominates energy usage at 51%, while attention overhead contracts to just 16%. Across both deployment settings, memory offloading and actuation decoding collectively account for under 11% of total consumption. This contrast highlights that optimization bottlenecks shift from quadratic token mixing on cloud servers to raw sensory I/O on physical robots.

paragraphs.section_or_role_zh: 双图关联与互补/因果印证段（Synthesizing Dual Charts）
paragraphs.paragraph_intent_zh: 我这一段想写双图题（如一张图是算力投入/研发经费变化，另一张图是模型误差/碳排放强度变化）的综合关联段，阐明两张图之间的内在协同或背离关系。
paragraphs.cohesion_formula: Global Correlation -> Co-movement Phase -> Diminishing Returns / Divergence -> Notable Outlier. 绑定逻辑规则：L007, L013.
paragraphs.paragraph_en: Cross-referencing both figures reveals a strong inverse relationship between automated inspection investment and manufacturing defect rates up to a $40 million threshold. Specifically, across plants investing between $10 million and $40 million (Figure 1), surface defect incidence dropped steeply from 4.8% to 0.9% (Figure 2). Beyond $40 million, however, further capital expenditure yielded diminishing returns: doubling investment to $80 million reduced defects by only an additional 0.1 percentage points. Notably, Plant D defied this expenditure curve, achieving a 0.7% defect rate with just $22 million through closed-loop sensor calibration.

paragraphs.paragraph_intent_zh: 我这一段想在图表或实验结果段中，专门挑出违背总体规律的 1–2 个异常点（Outliers）或局部反常尖峰进行精准描述与成因剖析。
paragraphs.cohesion_formula: General Rule vs. Notable Departure -> Quantitative Deviation -> Root Cause Attribution -> Calibration Takeaway. 绑定逻辑规则：L007, L013.
paragraphs.paragraph_en: Although deep spectral transformers outperform linear baselines across six of the seven benchmarks, a notable departure emerges on the financial Exchange-Rate dataset. Whereas complex attention models reduce MSE by 12%–18% on periodic energy and weather streams, they trail a single-layer DLinear baseline by 4.3% on Exchange-Rate. Autocorrelation analysis reveals that this reversal stems from the near-martingale nature of daily currency returns, where weak seasonal periodicity causes high-capacity attention layers to overfit transient market shocks. This anomaly confirms that model capacity must be matched to the intrinsic signal-to-noise ratio of the underlying stochastic process.
